_how: Penguin Rally's last maze, a race against David. Set maps: open is one hex digit per cell (bit 0 north, 1 east, 2 south, 3 west open), fish/you/david are cells, turns is the board's orientation (quarter turns) at the start and then every spin ms. run is David's recorded presses, [ms after Go, direction 0-3], from /hobbies/lumosity/?record=penguin; null until recorded. Changing a map throws its run away.
